record.question: In Excel, which of the following is not a valid chart type?
record.explanation: D is the uniquely best printed answer. Line and pie are Excel chart types, and Excel supports cylindrical 3-D bar/column representations: the official object model exposes Series.BarShape and xlCylinder. A flowchart is a process diagram made from shapes or SmartArt rather than an Excel numeric chart type. Whether cylinder is a subtype, series shape, or older chart-type label does not turn it into the same category as a flowchart or supply a second comparably good negative answer in this basic Excel question. Precision note: Cylinder is a supported 3-D bar/column form or shape; Flowchart is the process-diagram distractor rather than an Excel data-chart type. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.series.barshape; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.xlbarshape; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office
